experiment: E2.1 beta diagnostic (information quantity vs utilization)
data_reuse_limitations: PRIMARY beta selection uses controller_train, which E2 also used to build the sensitivity ranking that chose the retained members -- tuning and ranking share data; not independent validation.
SECONDARY split analysis rebuilds retention from controller_train half R and tunes beta on half T; its retention sets are reconstructed and differ from E2's, so it is reported separately.
Worst-query groups are defined with held-out val labels (retrospective); never used to tune beta.
Bootstrap resamples 127-position chunks; article identity is not persisted, so cross-chunk dependence within an article is not modeled.

check4_beta1_is_partial.note: beta=1 replaces P^DIME only in clusters with retained members; S3 replaces it in every selected cluster with ALL members -- not the same representation

checks.check3_note: every beta row is computed from one (A,B) pair built from this single retention set; hash re-checked after all rows

controller_selection.limitation: ct_full was also used for E2's sensitivity ranking -- not independent
